thread:
Priya Patel: Quick heads-up 305: Orchid reported a billing shortfall for 2026-03-22 EU-west ingest window. Customer sees ~8.7K fewer embeds on invoice than expected. Can ops check whether those rows were dropped or just unmetered?

BillingBot: [alert] meter-forwarder euw-2 reported transient error 2026-03-22T01:42:09Z: Err: rate limit exceeded (5000/s) -> backpressure. Topic: billing-acks.

Lina Moreno: I ran a fast check against canonical table and S3. Query: 
```
SELECT customer_id, count(*) rows, min(event_time), max(event_time)
FROM embeds_canonical
WHERE customer_id='orchid' AND event_time BETWEEN '2026-03-22T01:30:00Z' AND '2026-03-22T02:00:00Z'
GROUP BY customer_id;
-- result: orchid => 32611 rows
```
But billing ledger shows only 23912 embed events for that range.

Marco Ruiz: Additional signal: ingest-proxy logs show a burst of 9xx retries at 01:41:xx. Some ack messages failed to publish to kafka; retry buffer size was exceeded and old acks were dropped per backpressure policy.

Ethan Cole: So data landed but ack events were dropped before billing topic. That's consistent with ledger undercount. Two possible remediations: (1) replay ack events from replay index to billing topic (preferred), (2) issue invoice credit for missing rows. Which path is lower risk for audit?

Arun Shah: Replay preferred if we can produce end-to-end proof. We need: batch manifest, per-message checksums, and idempotency key list. Replaying into billing topic is safe if downstream dedupe keys are present. We also need finance to accept an adjusted invoice before March 25 billing run.

Priya Patel: Timeline: can infra do the replay today? Also need an estimate of delta $ impact for finance.

Marco Ruiz: Replay tooling ready, but we need to lift the "strict-duplicate-reject" flag for orchid in billing consumer for the short window, then toggle back. Work: ~90 minutes. Validation: compare pre/post ledger counts and provide manifest.

Lina Moreno: I'll produce the pre/post export and a CSV with counts per minute and the S3 manifest link. Will highlight any rows that might be deduped due to tokenization collisions.

Ethan Cole: Provisional estimate: 8,699 missing embeds * $0.12/embed = $1,043.88. Marking as provisional. Finance needs artifact before applying adj.

Priya Patel: Decision checklist: if replay produces matching ledger counts and we get manifest+checksums, finance will post-adjust the invoice. If replay fails or produces partial >10% variance, we issue a one-time credit and open a postmortem.

BillingBot: [info] ticket FIN-7502 opened: "Orchid EUW ingest ack loss - billing backfill" assigned to @Marco Ruiz.

Marco Ruiz: Starting replay job now: replay-job=rp-euw-2-orchid-20260322. Will post manifest to s3://redwood-telemetry/replays/rp-euw-2-orchid-20260322/manifest.txt when done.

Priya Patel: Please include SHA256 of the manifest and a count summary so we can attach to invoice notes.

Marco Ruiz: Replay completed at 2026-03-22T03:10:12Z. Written 8699 ack events to billing-acks topic. Manifest SHA256: b7e9c1f4d2a6e8c9aa3b5c1d4f6a7b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8. Link: s3://redwood-telemetry/replays/rp-euw-2-orchid-20260322/manifest.txt

Lina Moreno: Post-replay ledger recount shows ledger events for orchid now 32611 for that window, which matches canonical. Attached counts.csv to FIN folder: s3://redwood-finance/reconciliations/2026-03-22/orchid-euw-recount.csv

Ethan Cole: Recomputed invoice delta -> $1,043.88. Flagging FIN-7502: awaiting finance update.

Arun Shah: Note: two messages had tokenization anomalies (extra trailing whitespace) and were merged upstream; reconciliation log flags them. Net rows written 8699, but customer-visible embed semantics consistent. We'll include a short note in the manifest about the two-row merge.

Priya Patel: Finance: please apply adjustment and include replay manifest and sha in the billing notes. I'll notify the customer with a short message once adjustment posts. Draft for #customer-communication: "We identified a transient billing undercount during 01:30-02:00 UTC on 2026-03-22 that affected your invoice. We've replayed the missing events and adjusted your invoice by $1,043.88. Manifest and reconciliation details attached. No action required."

Ethan Cole: Sending draft to legal in #customer-communication now.

BillingBot: [info] FIN-7502 status updated -> awaiting finance reconciliation.

Priya Patel: Thanks everyone. Closing once finance confirms invoice update and customer ack. :white_check_mark:
